description.value:
Channeling Force-fueled strength into your legs, you leap up to 30 feet to any unoccupied space you can see, provided a clear path exists to it.

Casting this power with a force slot of 2nd level or higher adds 5 feet to the jump distance for each slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 1
